title: Charming Belmont/Green Hills Private Studio
description:
This charming yet sophisticated basement level apt will invite you to settle in and you may not want to leave!  Our guests love the king size bed and oversize chair and ottoman and bonus- you can watch tv from both. The kitchenette is equipped with microwave, toaster, mini-fridge, coffee maker, and ironing board. The bathroom is stocked with linens & toiletries. There is plenty of room in the walk-in closet for clothes/bags or make use of the dresser. This space is perfectly suited for 2 guests.
